name: io.github.B0yko/pgwarden
title: pgwarden
description: Give AI assistants access to Postgres with per-user permissions and human approval for writes.

runtimeArguments.name: -p
runtimeArguments.description: Publish the gateway's port; MCP clients connect to /mcp on it.

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: The directory holding pgwarden.yaml and secrets/ from docs/own-database.md (readable by uid 10001).

config_dir.description: Host directory with pgwarden.yaml and the secrets/ directory created by `pgwarden keys generate`.

environmentVariables.name: PGWARDEN_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to pgwarden.yaml inside the container.

environmentVariables.name: PGWARDEN_TARGET_DSN
environmentVariables.description: Target Postgres 16+ DSN: host, port and database, no user or password.

environmentVariables.name: PGWARDEN_STATE_DSN
environmentVariables.description: State database DSN, connecting as the pgwarden_app role that `pgwarden db init` creates.

environmentVariables.name: PGWARDEN_ROLE_SECRET_FILE
environmentVariables.description: File with the secret that derives each login role's SCRAM password.

environmentVariables.name: PGWARDEN_SIGNING_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: File with the Ed25519 key that signs access tokens.

environmentVariables.name: PGWARDEN_SESSION_SECRET_FILE
environmentVariables.description: File with the browser session secret.

environmentVariables.name: PGWARDEN_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET_FILE
environmentVariables.description: File with the client secret your identity provider issued for pgwarden.
